verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that brings Statsig data and experiments into agent tools such as Codex, Cursor and Claude Code. It also documents a separate no-key Docs MCP server at /api/mcp, and a probe confirms the official MCP documentation exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections, and detail on the server's tool surface and authentication/write capabilities.
